summary.content:
Today's selection covers 92 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 58 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI’s big Codex update is a direct shot at Claude Code
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Ronan Farrow on Sam Altman’s ‘unconstrained’ relationship with the truth
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
